capabilities: Render images, PDFs, iframes, and transclusions inside the editor
Resize images with alt-text size tags like #small
Invert image colors using the #invert alt-text tag
View files outside the vault via file:/// or app://local/ prefixes
Toggle rendering per embed type from settings or commands
extras: Since version 2.1.3 only the new editor's Source Mode is supported; widgets are disabled automatically under Live Preview to avoid duplicates. Legacy editor support ends at version 2.1.2, which must be installed manually.
problem: In the editor's Source Mode, embedded images, PDFs, iframes and transclusions show only as links, forcing users to switch to preview to see them.

relations.evidence: After a nice collaboration with Zsolt, you can now view excalidraw drawings within the Editor
you need to install MSG Handler plugin since the render engine is dependent on MSG Handler plugin
Plugin's link conversion functions are moved to Obsidian Link Converter Plugin

summary: Renders images, PDFs, iframes, transclusions, Excalidraw drawings, and MSG/EML files inline in the editor's Source Mode.
